description: Strategy geometry for 2026 REBUILT, in the ALLIANCE FRAME: feet, origin at the robot's own alliance wall corner, x toward the opponent wall, y to the driver's left. A red robot's field position is rotated 180 degrees about the field centre into this frame, so one team's red and blue matches compare directly.
provenance: Field size and hub centres are computed from contracts/fields/2026-apriltags.json (WPILib, surveyed): each hub centre is the midpoint of its eight face tags (blue hub tags 18-21, 24-27). Zone boundaries are placed at the hub centre lines; that is an approximation of the game's alliance-zone lines, not a transcription of the game manual.
